notes.title: Remothered: Broken Porcelain to Release One Week Early on October 13
notes.notes:
Today, we are excited to announce that Remothered: Broken Porcelain’s will be releasing one week earlier than its announced October 20th date! You will now be able to explore the halls of the Ashmann Inn on Tuesday, October 13th, 2020.

“This is an incredibly busy month for games, particularly horror games,” said Shane Bierwith, EVP of global marketing at Modus. “While moving dates forward isn’t common, we’d like to allow horror fans to get their hands on Broken Porcelain early so players can have more time to experience all the great games releasing around Halloween.”

Coming to PlayStation 4, Xbox One, Nintendo Switch, and PC for $29.99, Remothered: Broken Porcelain follows the critically lauded Remothered: Tormented Fathers and features new gameplay mechanics and narrative elements sure to spook even the bravest of players. Directed by Chris Darril of Darril Arts and developed by Stormind Games, Remothered: Broken Porcelain weaves events from the first entry into this all-new experience that pulls fans and newcomers alike into an incredibly immersive and haunting experience, all centered around the mysterious happenings of the Ashmann Inn.

Remothered: Broken Porcelain acts as both prequel and sequel to its predecessor. And while horror enthusiasts will now be able to explore its challenging puzzles, expanded lore and intense, complex characters one week earlier than expected, the experience is likely to haunt them well after the game is over.

Watch SOEDESCO's interview with Chris Darril, game designer, director and artist of Remothered: Tormented Fathers. The game touches many different subjects, such as the fear of being alone, identity struggles, and the contradictory relation between science and religion. This makes for a pure horror story with complex characters and cinematic storytelling.

notes.title: Remothered just got better! New improvements now available!

It’s Friday 13th, a great day for horror fans! We want to celebrate this day with you with a new update for Remothered: Tormented Fathers that takes the gaming experience to a whole new level.

Many of these new improvements have been requested by the community before and we are very happy to implement them. You know how much we care about our fans’ opinion and we’re sure this upgrade will make a lot of players happy.

[b]Improved textures for “low”, “medium” and “high” settings[/b]
Our developers have been working in order to optimize texture graphics quality when playing the game in lower quality settings. So, even if your hardware is not top of the line, textures now have a more realistic look!

[b]HQ texture mode[/b]
Do you own a powerful PC? Would you like to play Remothered: Tormented Fathers at the highest resolution your system allows? Just turn HQ Texture Mode on and enjoy the game in all its graphic glory!

[b]FOV setting[/b]
This feature has been requested by many and we’re very happy to make it available to everyone! We’ve implemented a slider that will allow you to change the field of view of the camera. notes.title: Steam Cloud support and Arabic and Korean localizations now available to Remothered: Tormented Fathers! (Plus another surprise...)
notes.notes:

Howdy, survival horror fans!

We’ve got some exciting news to share with you! Today, we’re rolling out an update that brings some of the most requested features by the community.

The first announcement is for [b]Arabic[/b] and [b]Korean[/b] speakers! You will be happy to know that the game has been localized in your languages! Welcome to the family!

Remothered: Tormented Fathers now supports [b]15 languages[/b]. That’s a great milestone for us and we’re happy to have more and more players from all around the globe who can fully enjoy the game.

Today’s update also brings [b]Steam Cloud[/b] support. This feature allows you to sync your progress over different devices. This is very helpful if you happen to play on different PC’s or if you’re planning to upgrade to a new computer. With Steam Cloud enabled, you don’t lose any of your data. It’s safely stored in the cloud, you don’t have to worry about that.

The patch that rolls out today also makes the gaming experience more pleasant, since it also brings bug fixing and [b]performance optimization[/b] under the hood.

To receive the update, just restart your Steam client. The patch will download and install automatically.

[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/633360/Remothered_Tormented_Fathers/?utm_source=steam&utm_campaign=torm&utm_medium=ann][b]If you haven’t yet, get Remothered: Tormented Fathers on Steam![/b][/url]

P.S.: What about the surprise? Well, here it is… Have you purchased the [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/748290/Remothered_Tormented_Fathers__Original_Soundtrack/][b]Original Soundtrack[/b][/url] or the [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/748291/Remothered_Tormented_Fathers__Artbook/][b]Digital Artbook[/b][/url] on Steam? The Original Soundtrack has become audiophile friendly since it also includes the files in FLAC lossless format. Just restart your Steam client to receive the updated DLC’s. Enjoy!

notes.notes:

Hi,

First things first, we would like to thank all the survival horror fans who’ve decided to support the game’s release. Remothered is quickly becoming a buzzword among horror players and this is very exciting for everyone of us at Darril Arts and Stormind Games.

We do care about your enthusiasm. That’s why we’re constantly listening to your suggestions: [b]your feedback is very important to us and we want to give you the purest survival horror gaming experience you can think of[/b].

As a matter of fact, we’ve just released a [b]patch[/b] that improves the game’s performances and fixes some minor issues. However, the most important change that comes with this new update involves [b]gameplay balance[/b].

Some of you have reported that the gameplay in the [spoiler]sewers[/spoiler] and in the [spoiler]attic[/spoiler] was not up to the standards of the rest of the game.

We’ve heard you loud and clear. Our developers have been working to finetune the gameplay in those areas to provide you an [b]engaging gaming experience[/b].

If you’ve abandoned the game in one of those areas, you will find this update useful. Those game sequences are now more balanced and you will have a smoother experience.

How to get the patch? [b]Just open your Steam client and wait for the update will automatically install![/b] We hope this new update will make you enjoy Remothered: Tormented Fathers more.

[b]If you’ve left a negative review of the game due to the unbalanced gameplay, we hope this new update will help you reconsider your opinion about it.[/b]

notes.title: Remothered fans from Hungary and China, we’ve got great news for you!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29153592/2d8466a0276f8d31bfad9018df2014c5844ff5a8.jpg[/img]

Hi there!

We’re thrilled to announce that we’ve completed [b]two more localizations[/b] for Remothered: Tormented Fathers!

So, please welcome...
Magyar!
繁體中文!

Today’s update brings [b]Hungarian[/b] and [b]traditional Chinese[/b] to Remothered: Tormented Fathers!

We’re very happy to have these new languages included in the game. [b]Remothered: Tormented Fathers is becoming increasingly popular in Hungary[/b]. As a matter of fact, PCGuru, which is one of the most popular video game magazines in Hungary, recently featured an exclusive interview with Chris Darril. Hungarian fans, we’re so thrilled to rely on your support and this is our “köszönöm” for you!

Chinese players, the other addition is for you: you will be glad to know that you can now [b]choose between traditional and simplified Chinese[/b]. Many of you prefer to play using subtitles in traditional Chinese. We can see that not having them can be a deal breaker for some. We’ve listened to your suggestions and now you can choose the language that better suits your needs!

These new additions join the roster of available languages which now comprises of [b]English, Italian, French, Spanish, Portuguese-Brazil, Turkish, Russian, German, Chinese (traditional and simplified), Japanese, Polish, Hungarian[/b].

Given the cinematographic nature of the game by Darril Arts, being able to completely understand all the dialogs is crucial to follow the evolution of the story. Offering this wide range of languages starting from the Early Access stage will allow gamers to immediately get into the story the way Chris Darril originally intended to.

[h1]Performance optimization[/h1]

This announcement is not just about the new localizations. Our devs have been working hard to [b]improve the game’s performance[/b], especially on hardware that is not top of the line.

We’re finally ready to release these improvements with today’s update! Even if these optimizations take place under the hood, the change is huge and you’ll definitely notice that [b]Remothered: Tormented Fathers will run a lot smoother after the update[/b].

All in all, this update will make a lot of players happy! Please, let us know in the comments below if you’ve experienced an upgrade in your gaming experience!

And if you happen to find any bugs, please report them at steamsupport@stormindgames.com so we can deal with them!

All the best,
Darril Arts & Stormind Games Team

Hello!
こんにちは!
Cześć!

[b]Japanese and Polish fans, rejoice![/b]

[b]We’ve just released an update that brings subtitles in these two languages![/b]

Right now, Remothered: Tormented Fathers is available in a total of 11 languages. More and more fans around the world can enjoy the game in their mother tongue and we cannot be happier about it!

Today’s update also brings several [b]improvements and bugfixes[/b]. The most noticeable advancement comes from a visual standpoint: the [b]diary[/b] (which is the menu to keep an eye on objectives, collectibles and events) has been [b]completely reworked[/b] in order to make user experience easier and more immediate.

[b]This menu is very important within the game[/b]: if you want to discover every detail about the story, complete all the objectives or simply refresh your memory about the events of the game, you’d better check this menu often!

We cannot wait to know what you think about these new additions! Keep following us to discover what will come next.

Oh, and if you happen to encounter a bug while playing, make sure to report it to steamsupport@stormindgames.com so we can work on it!

Thank you for your support,
Darril Arts and Stormind Games Team

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29153592/64f3e6a32624361ac3579a8d7dc234b178836fa6.jpg[/img]

Hi there!

First of all, we would like to thank you for trying the Early Access version of Remothered: Tormented Fathers! Your advice has been fundamental to improve the game under every aspect.

Right now, [b]88% of the reviews here on Steam are positive[/b] - as a matter of fact, the game is rated as “Very Positive”. That’s impressive. We’re very proud you’re enjoying the debut title of the pure and cinematic survival horror trilogy!

[b]That’s why we are so thrilled to announce the PC full release of Remothered: Tormented Fathers, that will come on January 30th 2018![/b]

When we announced the Early Access release, we told you that we weren’t far from the full release date. On average, released Early Access games spend 14 months in this stage. On the opposite side, Remothered: Tormented Fathers will spend a total of 91 days in Early Access. That’s quite a difference!

[b]Have you purchased the PC Early Access release? On January 30th, you will receive an update that will provide you the final release without any additional cost.[/b]

If you haven’t gotten the game yet, there’s something you need to know. Currently, Remothered: Tormented Fathers is $12.99. [b]On January 30th, the price will rise to $14.99[/b]. Do you want an advice? If you want to get the game at the lowest price possible, you’d better [url=store.steampowered.com/app/633360/Remothered_Tormented_Fathers/]get it right away[/url]! As you can see, there are a lot of gamers on Steam that are enjoying the game already… If you plan to get the game, we suggest you to take advantage of this period before the full release!

Think about it… But not for too long!

You may think January 30th is far far away, yet time flies… Without needing to think about it, the full version of Remothered: Tormented Fathers will be out (and the lowest price available will be gone)!

Even if you don’t plan to play the Early Access release, this is the best time to get the game. You’ll either have the chance to take advantage of the lowest price ever and you’ll automatically receive the full release on day one!

[b]Are you a PC gamer who loves survival horror? If that’s the case, you simply cannot miss the full release of Remothered: Tormented Fathers![/b] :)

Thank you for your support,
Remothered Team

notes.title: Remothered: Tormented Fathers - Early Access Update #2
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29153592/858a775209cc9f5687811a55608654ffb3838592.jpg[/img]

Hi,

Are you having a tough Monday? Don’t worry, we got great news for you…

[b]We’ve just released the second update to the early access version of Remothered: Tormented Fathers![/b]

What’s in this update?
[list]
[*]We’ve added a brightness slider in the settings.
[*]Saved games: we’ve added a tip that explains how to properly save. What’s more, now save slots are easier to identify.
[*]General GUI fixes: the one that you’ll notice the most is that it’s now easier to read texts from documents.
[*]3D audio has been massively improved. It will be more immediate for you to understand how closer your enemy is.
[*]The game’s lighting system has been improved.
[*]Sometimes, certain music tracks used to suddenly stop: with the new update it doesn’t happen anymore.
[*]Enemies can now grab Rosemary also when they’re in front of her, not only when they’re behind her.
[*]We’ve improved camera movements when Rosemary clashes with her enemies.
[*]Some users reported input loss when the inventory is opened: it’s been fixed.
[*]Under certain circumstances, choosing custom video settings didn’t result in any changes: this has been fixed as well.
[*]You won’t see the annoying “subtitle not found” message anymore.
[*]This is for French speaking gamers: you will be glad to know that we’ve fixed subtitles in your language! :)
[*]Minor bug fixes.
[/list]

And here you have other improvements that may be full of [b]SPOILERS[/b] if you haven’t finished the Early Access version:

[list]
[*][spoiler]We’ve added a sound particle to the recorder you have in Celeste’s room.
[*][spoiler]There were some issues with QTEs that have been fixed.[/spoiler]
[*][spoiler]When Rosemary happened to die while in crouch, blood wasn’t visible: now you can see it![/spoiler]
[*][spoiler]There’s a new addition to Richard’s AI when he doesn’t stalk you: sometimes, you’ll spot him in the kitchen preparing some meat![/spoiler]
[*][spoiler]We’ve added sound effects when Rosemary meets Arianna.[/spoiler]
[*][spoiler]Moths appear only when the Red Nun is around.[/spoiler]
[/list]

Thank you for letting us know your opinions about the game. [b]Your feedback is very important to all of us![/b]

We hope this new update will enhance your gaming experience!

All the best,
Darril Arts & Stormind Games Team

notes.title: Remothered: Tormented Fathers - Early Access Update #1
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29153592/183703e34982ff40168f0f66f3e0d63fc02a881a.jpg[/img]

Hi there!

First of all, thank you for playing the early access release of Remothered: Tormented Fathers! Your feedback is very important to all of us at Darril Arts and Stormind Games.

As a matter of fact, we’ve just released the first update to add some of the features you’ve requested and improve the overall gaming experience.

[b]These are the improvements we’re releasing today[/b]
[list]
[*]Improved system for text localization.
[*]Improved text formatting.
[*]Option to invert camera axis in settings is now implemented.
[*]Translation improvements.
[*]Improved settings menu navigation with gamepad.
[*]Main menu volume is now lowered.
[*]QTE animation are not appearing anymore during game over screens.
[*]Scrollbox behavior is now fixed.
[*]GUI fixes (icon changes, layout improvements).
[/list]

We’ve also fixed bugs that interfered with the game’s progress. These bugs may include potential spoilers, so [b]if you haven’t played the game yet, please DON’T READ the text below[/b]:
[list]
[*][spoiler]Under certain circumstances, it wasn't possible to find the tape recorder in Celeste’s room: this has been fixed.[/spoiler]
[*][spoiler]Enemies cannot spot Rosemary when she’s in the bathroom anymore.[/spoiler]
[*][spoiler]Interaction with the ladder in the basement is now improved.[/spoiler]
[*][spoiler]When Rosemary is hung on the wall, Richard used to randomly disappear: this doesn't happen anymore.
[*][spoiler]The part involving Jennifer and the TV remote didn’t work as expected for some and it’s now fixed.[/spoiler]
[/list]

We hope these improvements and bugfixes will make your gaming experience better! Thank you for your suggestions! Keep ‘em coming ;)

All the best,
Darril Arts & Stormind Games Team

notes.title: Remothered: Tormented Fathers is now available in Early Access!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29153592/4f5a4969ad929db419535236ba6859efe2fd4bd0.jpg[/img]

We are thrilled to announce that the first title of the survival horror trilogy Remothered is now available to PC gamers via Steam’s Early Access program!

The franchise makes its debut just in time for Halloween, the scariest night of the year!

Since this is not the final version of the game, there’s still a chance users can experience bugs and find imperfections. In order to improve the final release of the game, we encourage gamers to send their feedback about gameplay and localizations to steamsupport@stormindgames.com.

For this Early Access release, we’ve added new subtitles to the game. The Early Access release of “Remothered: Tormented Fathers” features English, Spanish, Italian, French, Brazilian Portuguese, Russian and Turkish subtitles.

“Remothered: Tormented Fathers” is expected to be in Early Access just for a few months. During the Early Access stage, the game will be €12,99. The price of the final release, however, will be the same or higher. As a consequence, The EA release is not to be missed for those who want to play the game at the lowest price possible!

Those who will purchase the EA version will also get the final release, once it comes out, without any additional cost.

Enjoy “Remothered: Tormented Fathers” and have a great Halloween at Dr. Felton’s house! 🎃

notes.title: Remothered: Tormented Fathers will be released in Early Access on October 31st!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29153592/2e205162c9c9ce47e3c8d131e9d8e79df51cbc9e.jpg[/img]

Hi!

Do you have any plans for [b]Halloween[/b]? Well, you’d better find a way to get rid of them, because [b]“Remothered: Tormented Fathers”[/b] will be released just in time for the scariest night of the year!

The first title of the survival horror trilogy designed by Darril Arts and developed by Stormind Games will hit the largest digital distribution platform for PC gaming on [b]October 31st[/b].

Chris started talking about Remothered some years ago, releasing concepts, sketches and plot details. Day by day he has gathered a community made of people who share his same idea of survival horror. This vision has now evolved, but it wouldn’t have been possible without the relentless [b]support of the community[/b].

That’s why we’re so happy to share with you this milestone for the trilogy: this is the first version of the game available to the public and we cannot wait to share it both with the fans of “Remothered” who have never abandoned the project and with those who have recently discovered the game and have been fascinated by it.

[b]This Early Access release is for the survival horror fans who want to take part in the development and play “Remothered: Tormented Fathers” before anyone else.[/b]

We want to make it absolutely clear: we have chosen Early Access not for the funding possibilities (as a matter of fact, the game is completely funded already), but because [b]this is the best way to involve you in the development[/b].

With this EA release, you will have the chance to play about two-thirds of the whole game. In order to discover the final part of “Remothered: Tormented Fathers”, you will have to wait for the final release. And, when the final release will be out, you will either choose to start the game from the beginning or from your last save point (or from the end of the EA version, if you’ll complete it before the final release).

The audio of the Early Access version is English only. This release will also feature English, French and Italian subtitles. The final game will be dubbed and subtitled in more languages.

Just like any other game that releases through Steam’s Early Access program, by purchasing the EA version, you will get the final release once it will be out without any additional cost. Speaking about the price, the final release will be priced the same or higher compared to the Early Access version…  [b]So, if you want to be sure to get the game at the lowest price possible, you’d better purchase it on October 31st[/b]!

Rest assured, we’re very close to the full release and [b]we’ll stay in Early Access for just a few months[/b]. However, if you want to be the first to help Rosemary in her investigations, you [i]have[/i] to get the game on October 31st!

Do you want to learn more about the Early Access release? [b][url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/633360/Remothered_Tormented_Fathers/?utm_source=steam&utm_campaign=torm&utm_medium=ann]Have a look to our Steam’s page[/url][/b] to discover everything you need to know about the first release ever of “Remothered: Tormented Fathers”!

Are you ready to get inside Dr. Felton’s house? Halloween is getting closer…
